text.description_html:
RK International CK-316, White Porcelain Knob with Traditional Rose

The White Porcelain Cabinet Knob with Metal Center has a retro feel. It manages to be glamorous while remaining simple. The white porcelain brings a freshness to home decor, appearing bright and clean. The metal base in the center is a great juxtaposition to the delicateness of the porcelain, merging the hard and soft elements into a cohesive look. Choose from polished brass, satin nickel, oil rubbed bronze, and polished chrome finishes for the brass tip and the rose (click picture to the right to see them all).

Also Available Matching: 1" White Porcelain Cabinet Knob with Metal Center and Black Porcelain Cabinet Knob with Metal Center

Specifications and Features of the RK International CK 316 White Porcelain Knob with Metal Tip:

  • Material: Porcelain with Brass Stem
  • Porcelain Color: White
  • Diameter: 1-1/4"
  • Projection: 1-3/8"
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
